title: Trump International Hotel and Tower Chicago
visualBrief: Chicago riverfront tower with four rounded glass volumes, asymmetric terraces, stainless bands, mapped ornamental spire and river-facing lettering.

nativeAxes.origin: Ground-level center of signed mapped footprint at the tower entrance datum

sourceFacts.facadeCladding: ALPOLIC/fr hairline stainless metal on columns, spandrels and soffits

reconstruction.plan: Exact signed whole-building and seven independent upper/antenna outlines
reconstruction.floors: Published92 marketed storeys distributed through mapped60/120/200/345 m stages; intermediate map heights are approximate
reconstruction.sign: Original serif strokes approximate the installed stainless lettering, using the installer’s140ft overall span

scaleBasis: Published owner/architect/contractor heights and distinguishing construction systems; map footprint for local orientation, with reconstructed details declared separately.
geometrySource: Original deterministic exterior geometry; no downloaded meshes or copied photographic textures. Footprint-derived registration includes separately attributed OpenStreetMap evidence.
sourceLicense: Original reconstruction under repository license. Map-derived plan evidence: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Reference publications are linked, not redistributed.
materialMethod: Canonical shared material graphs bound through molenSurface extras with metric coordinates divided by central repeat meters. Vertex colors provide component tint. Glass retains opaque metallic-roughness PBR; no bitmap texture copies per model.
reviewStatus: source-geometry; near/far and shared-material captures pending
limitations: Original 80651-triangle, 7471112-byte detailed master remains exactly reproducible from the unchanged global recipe. Reviewed source and four browser levels retain four rounded asymmetric mapped volumes, three setbacks, pale stainless floor bands, tall offset crown and a three-section 423.2 m spire. Near levels retain the reconstructed Wabash canopy, terrace rails/selected planting and original geometric serif sign. Distant levels aggregate floor/column coverage and terrace detail; skyline keeps a sign band instead of legible letters. Continuous glazing plus long strips replace per-cell frames, and the canopy uses thin opaque upper/lower daylight glazing faces. Intermediate stage heights are approximate map data, not surveyed sections; marketed 92 floors differ from current CVU 98, while occupied height 340.1 m and architectural/tip height 423.2 m agree. Crown/antenna radii derive from the mapped parts; panel rhythm, canopy ribs/curvature, serif stroke widths, planting and exact sign elevation are reconstructed. The 140 ft sign span follows its installer. Three shared 256 px concrete, stainless and granite graphs; no embedded images or copied photographic textures. Riverwalk descending terraces, underground/double-helix parking ramp, interiors, exact entrance thresholds and terrain slope remain outside the tower-shell asset. No terrain-grade or physical phone/laptop performance claim.
importReason: Preserve thin facade frames, panel joints and crown/antenna details until a measured LOD chain is authored.
